en.headline: Police smash Fanling meth lab, seize drugs worth HK$23m
en.dek: Three people were arrested after officers found solid and liquid methamphetamine plus active manufacturing equipment in a tin-sheet structure in Chi Tong Tsuen.
body: Police have dismantled a suspected methamphetamine manufacturing laboratory in a Fanling tin-sheet structure, seizing about 9 kilograms of solid and 43 litres of liquid suspected ice with an estimated street value of HK$23 million.

Narcotics Bureau officers acted on the evening of 17 September after stopping a 49-year-old mainland man holding a two-way permit near Chi Tong Tsuen. Keys recovered from him led to a loft unit containing heaters, filters, reactors and refrigeration equipment, some of which were still operating.

Officers later arrested a non-ethnic Chinese woman holding a recognizance form and a local man in a nearby tin-sheet structure and a unit in Shun Tin Estate, Sau Mau Ping. The three, who police said did not know one another and had been recruited for money, were detained for investigation on suspicion of manufacturing a dangerous drug. They are due to appear at Fanling Magistrates’ Courts on Monday.
Police said the operation removed a significant quantity of drugs from the market and eliminated a serious fire and explosion risk in a densely populated residential area.

zh.headline: 警方搗粉嶺鐵皮屋製毒工場 檢值2300萬冰毒拘三人
zh.dek: 單位內製毒設備仍在運作，另檢大量化學品；三名被捕人據稱受金錢利誘加入，周一提堂。
body: 警方搗破粉嶺一個懷疑製毒工場，檢獲約9公斤固體及約43公升液態懷疑冰毒，估計市值2300萬港元，並拘捕兩男一女。
毒品調查科於9月17日晚上在粉嶺祠堂村附近截查一名持雙程證的49歲內地男子，並在其身上搜出鎖匙，其後搜查附近鐵皮屋閣樓單位，發現加熱器、過濾器、反應器及冷凍設備，部分仍在運作。
人員其後於附近另一鐵皮屋及秀茂坪順天邨單位拘捕一名持「行街紙」的非華裔女子及一名本地男子。三人報稱無業，據悉互不相識，受金錢利誘擔任製毒師、跑腿及睇水角色，現正被扣留，涉嫌製造危險藥物，下周一於粉嶺裁判法院提堂。
警方表示，行動成功截擊大批毒品流入市場，並及時排除高密度住宅區內極具爆炸性的社區安全隱患。
